paper.title_en: Search for wobbling modes in $A\approx 100$ nuclei: Mo, Ru, Pd isotopes
paper.abstract_en: The possible existence of wobbling mode in the $A \approx 100$ mass region is examined for the odd mass isotope chains of $^{97,99,101,103}$Mo, $^{101,103,105,107}$Ru, and $^{103,105,107,109}$Pd by combining constrained triaxial relativistic density functional theory (RDFT) and quantum particle rotor model (PRM). The RDFT calculations yield several states with the obvious triaxial deformation and a high-j particle configuration $\nu h_{11/2},$ which enable the establishment of wobbling modes in these isotopes. A detailed analysis of the corresponding energy spectrum, electromagnetic transition probabilities, and azimuthal plots is performed within the PRM framework. The present results suggest that the wobbling mode could be of a general nature in the $A \approx 100$ mass region, thereby providing a theoretical basis for future experimental searches.
